title: Polling
description: Learn how to implement real-time updates with polling.

data.text: **Polling** repeatedly executes a query at specified intervals to keep data fresh. It's a simple way to achieve near real-time updates.

data.title: Polling
Subscriptions vs Polling
data.text: For true real-time updates, use GraphQL subscriptions instead of polling. Polling is simpler but less efficient.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Polling is simple but subscriptions are more efficient.
